22:def _poly_iw(sys):
23:    """Apply s = iw to G(s)=num(s)/den(s)
24:
25:    Splits the num and den polynomials with (iw) applied into real and
26:    imaginary parts with w applied
27:    """
28:    num = sys.num[0][0]
29:    den = sys.den[0][0]
30:    num_iw = (1J)**np.arange(len(num) - 1, -1, -1) * num
31:    den_iw = (1J)**np.arange(len(den) - 1, -1, -1) * den
32:    return num_iw, den_iw

36:    return np.real(np.polymul(pol_iw, pol_iw.conj()))

39:def _poly_iw_real_crossing(num_iw, den_iw, epsw):
40:    # Return w where imag(H(iw)) == 0
41:
42:    # Compute the imaginary part of H = (num.r + j num.i)/(den.r + j den.i)
43:    test_w = np.polysub(np.polymul(num_iw.imag, den_iw.real),
44:                        np.polymul(num_iw.real, den_iw.imag))
45:
46:    # Find the real-valued w > 0 where imag(H(iw)) = 0
47:    w = np.roots(test_w)
48:    w = np.real(w[np.isreal(w)])
49:    w = w[w >= epsw]
50:
51:    return w

54:def _poly_iw_mag1_crossing(num_iw, den_iw, epsw):
55:    # Return w where |H(iw)| == 1, |num(iw)| - |den(iw)| == 0
56:    w = np.roots(np.polysub(_poly_iw_sqr(num_iw), _poly_iw_sqr(den_iw)))
57:    w = np.real(w[np.isreal(w)])
58:    w = w[w > epsw]
59:    return w

62:def _poly_iw_wstab(num_iw, den_iw, epsw):
63:    # Stability margin: minimum distance to point -1
64:    # find zero derivative. Second derivative needs to be >0
65:    # to have a minimum
66:    test_wstabn = _poly_iw_sqr(np.polyadd(num_iw, den_iw))
67:    test_wstabd = _poly_iw_sqr(den_iw)
68:    test_wstab = np.polysub(
69:        np.polymul(np.polyder(test_wstabn), test_wstabd),
70:        np.polymul(np.polyder(test_wstabd), test_wstabn))
71:
72:    # find the solutions, for positive omega, and only real ones
73:    wstab = np.roots(test_wstab)
74:    wstab = np.real(wstab[np.isreal(wstab)])
75:    wstab = wstab[wstab > epsw]
76:
77:    # and find the value of the 2nd derivative there, needs to be positive
78:    wstabplus = np.polyval(np.polyder(test_wstab), wstab)
79:    wstab = wstab[wstabplus > 0.]
80:    return wstab

83:def _poly_z_invz(sys):
84:    num = sys.num[0][0]  # num(z) = a_p * z^p + a_(p-1) * z^(p-1) + ... + a_0
85:    den = sys.den[0][0]  # num(z) = b_q * z^p + b_(q-1) * z^(q-1) + ... + b_0
86:    p_q = len(num) - len(den)
87:    if p_q > 0:
88:        raise ValueError("Not a proper transfer function: Denominator must "
89:                         "have equal or higher order than numerator.")
90:    num_inv_zp = num[::-1]  # num(1/z) * z^p
91:    den_inv_zq = den[::-1]  # den(1/z) * z^q
92:    return num, den, num_inv_zp, den_inv_zq, p_q, sys.dt

96:    # z = exp(1J w dt)
97:    # |z| == 1 with some float precision tolerance
98:    z = z[np.abs(np.abs(z) - 1.) < eps]
99:    zarg = np.angle(z)
100:    zidx = (0 <= zarg) * (zarg < np.pi)
101:    omega = zarg[zidx] / dt
102:    return z[zidx], omega
